title: SUNBURST suspicious SolarWinds child processes (Normalized Process Events)
description:
Identifies suspicious child processes of SolarWinds.Orion.Core.BusinessLayer.dll that may be evidence of the SUNBURST backdoor
References:
- https://www.fireeye.com/blog/threat-research/2020/12/evasive-attacker-leverages-solarwinds-supply-chain-compromises-with-sunburst-backdoor.html
- https://gist.github.com/olafhartong/71ffdd4cab4b6acd5cbcd1a0691ff82f
To use this analytics rule, make sure you have deployed the [ASIM normalization parsers](https://aka.ms/ASimProcessEvent)'
query: ('Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Security Events') and ('Process Name' like '*solarwinds.businesslayerhost.exe') and (not(('Process Name' like '*\\\\SolarWinds\\\\Orion\\\\APM\\\\APMServiceControl.exe*' or 'Process Name' like '*\\\\SolarWinds\\\\Orion\\\\ExportToPDFCmd.Exe*' or 'Process Name' like '*\\\\SolarWinds.Credentials\\\\SolarWinds.Credentials.Orion.WebApi.exe*' or 'Process Name' like '*\\\\SolarWinds\\\\Orion\\\\Topology\\\\SolarWinds.Orion.Topology.Calculator.exe*' or 'Process Name' like '*\\\\SolarWinds\\\\Orion\\\\Database-Maint.exe*' or 'Process Name' like '*\\\\SolarWinds.Orion.ApiPoller.Service\\\\SolarWinds.Orion.ApiPoller.Service.exe*' or 'Process Name' like '*\\\\Windows\\\\SysWOW64\\\\WerFault.exe*')))

ask_ai_prompts: Summarize the Microsoft Sentinel converted detection results and identify the highest-risk pivots.
